episodes.209185: A strong cold front brought gale- to storm-force winds in snow showers to the tidal waters of the Potomac River and Chesapeake Bay early on New Year's morning.
episodes.210056: A low pressure system from the southwest tapped into anomalously moist tropical air as it pushed into Southern California on New Year's Day. This allowed for some heavy rainfall rates and flooding, especially near the San Diego Metro. There were several reports of flooding along the San Diego River. Showers continued off and on in the following days, but impacts were limited after New Year's Day.
episodes.210116: A landspout tornado was spotted near Three Points, AZ. The tornado caused no damage or injury. The time and location of the tornado was estimated by radar. The landspout tornado was left unrated due to the remote location and would be difficult to survey.
episodes.210865: After a prolonged period of light to moderate rainfall across the two counties, a strong atmospheric river brought heavy rain to the area on January 5th. This resulted in numerous reports of flooding and closed highways, particularly in the two county area.
